messages.interactiveNotice: Interactive choices and personal preferences require JavaScript. Personal saved items remain in your browser.
messages.aboutText: WexaShelf is app discovery and comparison software developed by Softwexa. Deployments can be operated by different organizations. The software developer is not necessarily the site operator or data controller. The catalog does not cover every store or app.
messages.privacyText: Saved apps, comparisons and theme preferences stay in browser storage. Administration uses a server-verified session cookie. Content and correction reports are stored in the installation database. Do not include passwords, payment details or other people’s private information in reports. External sites have their own privacy policies. When submissions are enabled, app details, store links and images are stored for editorial review. Optional contact details stay private and are not copied to the public app. Anyone with the tracking code can read or withdraw an eligible submission; keep it private. No email notifications are sent. Unfinished drafts expire after seven days of inactivity. Owners can delete closed submissions; backups may retain earlier copies. Hosting access logs may include connection data.
messages.methodologyText: Information compiled from official documentation is not presented as hands-on testing. Unknown information does not mean absent or free. Store listings, platform support and feature scope are separate. Editorial lists are not download rankings. Comparisons and cost calculations are limited to documented records.
messages.correctionsText: Report outdated or incorrect information from the app detail page, with the affected field and an official source if possible. Reports enter an editorial queue and are not automatically published. Accepted changes create a new revision. Important changes require another SEO review.
messages.growthDescription: Source-backed editorial resources. Publication and review status are recorded for each page.
messages.staleGrowth: Linked app information changed. This page is awaiting source review.
messages.toolsDescription: Compare documented quotas, formats and migration evidence. Unknown fields remain unknown.

messages.submissionNotice: Submit app information, official store links and images for editorial review, or use a private tracking code to check an existing submission. Sending a submission does not publish it or verify developer identity.
